constraints.meaning: At least one character, at most 100,000.
constraints.impact: O(n²) is about 10¹⁰ steps: far too slow. One pass, O(n), is the target. With one character there is nothing to swap.

constraints.text: s[i] is a printable ASCII character
constraints.impact: Every character is treated the same: no skipping, no case changes. Only positions matter.

constraints.text: Modify s in place with O(1) extra memory (statement)
constraints.meaning: You may not build a reversed copy.
constraints.impact: Rules out 'copy backwards into a new array'. Swap characters inside s instead: the first with the last, the second with the second-to-last, and so on.

bruteForce.summary: build a reversed copy, then copy it back into s: O(n) time, but O(n) extra memory, which breaks the O(1) rule. Two pointers swap in place with O(1) memory.
